urdu: شریف خاندان کے کس فرد نے تین بار پاکستان کے وزیر اعظم کی حیثیت سے خدمات انجام دیں؟
english: Which member of the Sharif family served as the Prime Minister of Pakistan three times?
roman_1: Sharif khandan ke kis fard ne teen dafa Pakistan ke Wazir e Azam ki haisiyat se khidmaat anjam deen?
roman_2: Sharif family ka kon sa fard teen baar Pakistan ka Wazir e Azam raha?
roman_3: Sharif khandan ka kon sa insaan teen martaba Pakistan ka Wazir e Azam bana?
